Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/NNNNN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26835` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26835 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6450901444, verbatim: "**p2:** the Studio hook form cannot author `refusals`, because the generic `record` editor stamps each entry's key into a closed entry. Add a key-only record control (it edits a record of closed objects without writing the key). It is a follow-up of #26170." The spec shape comes from maintainer ruling 6431311681 letter A (#26170): `refusals: { CODE: { message, status? } }`, with each entry a closed object (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` ≈L204-260, ≈L595). No further ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` `e6e41998`; disproof welcome)

- PR #26831 (merged 2026-10-28 02:23Z) recorded `refusals` as an omission in the Studio hook form's gate ledger. Find that row from #26831's diff, along with the form definition the hook form renders from. Removing the row is part of this card.
- The generic `record` editor that stamps the key into each entry: find it (the form-field registry under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` or `@object-ui/fields`) and measure the stamping. ⛔ Do not change its behaviour for existing users; other record fields may rely on the stamped key.
- New: a **generic** key-only record control. It edits `Record<string, closedObject>`: add, rename and remove keys, and edit each entry's fields, without writing the key into the value. Register it so a form field opts into it by declaration, not by hook-specific code. Then declare `refusals` on the hook form with that control. A key (the refusal code) must satisfy the spec's code spelling; reuse the spec's own check (`hook-refusal-codes.ts`), and ⛔ do not copy the regex.
- Round-trip: a hook authored in Studio with two refusals saves a body that `HookSchema` accepts byte-for-byte (no stamped key), and reloads into the same rows.

### Scope

File surface: the key-only control (new, in the generic form-field home), its registration, the hook form definition, the gate ledger row, i18n keys (en + zh; the other locales as the repo's i18n gates demand), and tests. Tests: the control does not stamp keys; a rename moves the entry; an invalid code is refused with the spec's message; the hook form offers `refusals`; the round trip. Ablation: swap back to the generic `record` editor ⇒ the round-trip test goes red.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface. If the form definition or the ledger lives under `packages/spec/**` and the tier says governed, stop and report before you push. Otherwise `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium`. `Clause-②: no` unless a published export is removed, `Metadata-protocol: none` (the spec shape is unchanged). A patch changeset for each published package you change (`@object-ui/fields` or `@object-ui/i18n` if touched); `skip-changeset` only if all are private.
